missions.title: Read an analog temperature sensor with ESP32, then send it to Altrobyte Cloud

scenarios.name: fresh_start
scenarios.label: Start from scratch
scenarios.description: A beginner with a board plugged in and no project yet. You write the files.
scenarios.opening: Hi, I want to read a temperature sensor with my ESP32.

scenarios.name: bare_pc
scenarios.label: Nothing installed
scenarios.description: A computer with no VS Code or PlatformIO.
scenarios.opening: I've never done this before. Where do I start?

scenarios.name: board_missing
scenarios.label: Board missing
scenarios.opening: I clicked upload but it just shows an error.

scenarios.name: driver_missing
scenarios.label: Driver missing
scenarios.description: Board is plugged in but its USB driver is missing.
scenarios.opening: My board is plugged in but upload fails.

scenarios.name: wrong_chip_board
scenarios.label: Wrong chip board
scenarios.description: platformio.ini names a board for a different chip.
scenarios.opening: Upload fails with some chip error.

scenarios.name: undeclared_pin
scenarios.label: Undeclared pin
scenarios.description: The code uses TEMP_PIN but never declares it.
scenarios.opening: The build fails and I don't understand why.

scenarios.name: baud_mismatch
scenarios.label: Baud mismatch
scenarios.description: Serial monitor speed does not match the code: garbage on screen.
scenarios.opening: My serial monitor shows weird characters instead of the temperature.

scenarios.name: adc2_with_wifi
scenarios.label: Adc2 with wifi
scenarios.description: Sensor is on an ADC2 pin: fine alone, dead once Wi-Fi is on.
scenarios.opening: It worked before, but after I added Wi-Fi the temperature shows minus 50.

scenarios.name: wrong_formula
scenarios.label: Wrong formula
scenarios.description: Uses the Arduino Uno conversion: absurd temperatures.
scenarios.opening: The temperature shows 400 degrees, that can't be right.

scenarios.name: reading_stuck_low
scenarios.label: Reading stuck low
scenarios.description: Sensor output wire is shorted to ground: always 0.

scenarios.name: reading_stuck_high
scenarios.label: Reading stuck high
scenarios.description: Sensor output wire is on 3.3 V: always at the top.
scenarios.opening: The temperature is always around 280 and never changes.

scenarios.name: wrong_mqtt_credentials
scenarios.label: Wrong mqtt credentials
scenarios.description: Wrong MQTT password: Wi-Fi works, nothing reaches the cloud.
scenarios.opening: Wi-Fi is connected but nothing shows up on my Altrobyte dashboard.

scenarios.name: wrong_topic
scenarios.label: Wrong topic
scenarios.opening: Nothing arrives on my dashboard but there are no errors.

scenarios.name: wrong_payload
scenarios.label: Wrong payload
scenarios.description: Publishes a bare number instead of the JSON the platform expects.
scenarios.opening: Data arrives on my topic but the dashboard stays empty.
